title: Von Miller wants to wear No. 40, has offers out to FB Hunter Luepke

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Von Miller wants to wear No. 40, has offers out to FB Hunter Luepke
sources.description: Von Miller doesn't currently have a number on the Cowboys' official roster, and a day after signing a one-year deal with the team, he doesn't know what his number will be.
